description: The plot illustrates the results of DPR with different expansion methods on the dev set of MS-Marco, comparing the performance across various numbers of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" with a linear scale, ranging from 2 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is unlabeled but has a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines: a blue line with a circle marker and solid style representing "DPR w/o query expansion", starting at approximately 33.4 at S=2 and increasing to around 35.1 at S=10; a red line with a triangle marker and solid style for "DPR w/ corpus expansion", beginning at about 34.7 at S=2 and rising to roughly 35.7 at S=10; a green line with a square marker and solid style for "DPR w/ document expansion", starting at approximately 34.8 at S=2 and reaching around 35.8 at S=10; and a purple line with a diamond marker and solid style for "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion", beginning at about 34.3 at S=2 and increasing to roughly 35.3 at S=10. All lines show an upward trend as the number of queries used during inference increases.
